sources.label: HushPine Morphe patches for PineDrama.
sources.author: HushPine
patch_list: Advanced downloads

Adds more ways to save: pick the video quality, save full-size photos, the sound on its own or a photo post as one video, hold a profile picture or story to save it, save a story or a video's cover from the share sheet, and pick videos on…
Allow Duet and Stitch

Shows the Duet and Stitch buttons on videos whose creator turned them off, so you can still make one, and Add to Story in the share sheet when the creator turned off content reuse. PineDrama may still refuse some videos or the upload. Star…
Allow photo comments

Lets PineDrama's comment box ask PineDrama's server about photo comments, like PineDrama does. PineDrama's server still decides whether your account can post one. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPine settings > Comments.
Allow screenshots and Circle to Search
Lets screenshots, screen recordings and Circle to Search work on PineDrama screens that would otherwise come out black. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPine settings > App, then restart PineDrama.
Always show publish date

Shows the date a video was posted next to the creator's name, so you can tell how old it is. It can also show the exact time, dates and lengths on profile grids, or sort the videos a grid has loaded. On by default. Turn it off in HushPine…
Automatic video advance
Moves on to the next video by itself when one ends, so you can watch hands-free. It can also turn on PineDrama's auto scroll in search results. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPine settings > Playback.
Block contact list access
Gives PineDrama an empty contact list when it tries to read your phone's contacts, so it can't use them to suggest friends. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPine settings > Privacy.
Block installed app scanning

Gives PineDrama an empty list when it asks which apps are on your phone, so it learns less about you. Opening another app from PineDrama still works. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPine settings > Privacy.
Block P2P video relay

Removes the files PineDrama uses to pass videos on to other viewers through your phone's internet connection. The app gets about 3.5 MB smaller. It's built in while patching, so only patching again without it brings them back.
Block suggested video notifications

Stops PineDrama's "Videos you might like" notifications about popular videos it picked for you. Messages, comments, likes and posts from people you follow still come through. On by default. Turn it off in HushPine settings > Inbox.
Camera and microphone indicator
Shows a small mark in the top corner while PineDrama is using the camera or microphone, so you always know when it is. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPine settings > Privacy.
Change app name
Shows a name you choose under the app icon, so the patched PineDrama is easy to tell apart from another copy. Type the name in this patch's options. Inside the app it still says PineDrama.
Comment publish diagnostics

Adds a note to HushPine's diagnostic report about how far a comment got when it fails to post, which helps track down comments that vanish without an error. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.
Comment send fix
Fixes comments that PineDrama sometimes drops without any message, so the comment you send actually posts. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.
Comment sort controls

Shows PineDrama's full comment sort menu on every video, with hot, newest, media and creator options, even when your account only got a cut-down version. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPine settings > Comments.
Copy comments without username
When you copy a comment, you get just its text, without the username in front. On by default. Turn it off in HushPine settings > Comments.
Create stickers

Adds a Create button to the Saved page of the comment sticker panel. Pick a photo and it turns into one of your saved stickers. Make sticker in a video's share sheet does the same with its cover. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no s…
Custom offline videos limit

Lets you pick how many videos PineDrama saves for watching offline, from 1 to 10,000, and keep them until you delete them. Handy when you're often without internet. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPine settings > Downloads.
Device privacy guard

Stops PineDrama reading what you copied and gives it a blank advertising ID. Can also hide a VPN connection and root status with details about root tools, and give PineDrama a new device identity. Each switch starts off in HushPine setting…
Diagnostic tools
Adds logs and reports you can save or share when something goes wrong, so a problem is easier to report and fix. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPine settings > Diagnostics.
Disable login requirement
Stops PineDrama from forcing you to sign in before you can keep browsing. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.
Disable screen capture detection
Stops PineDrama from noticing and reacting when you take a screenshot or record the screen. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.
Disable the long press quick share
Stops a long press on Share from opening PineDrama's quick share, so you don't send a video by accident. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPine settings > Feed screen.
Disable the long press repost
Stops a long press on Like from opening PineDrama's repost option, so you don't repost by accident. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPine settings > Feed screen.
Downloads

Saves videos and photos without PineDrama's watermark, even when the creator turned downloads off. You can also choose the folders and file names. On by default. Turn it off in HushPine settings > Downloads.
Drop the animated image cache

Lets you make PineDrama decode animated stickers and GIFs one frame at a time as they play, instead of a few frames ahead, so they use a little less memory. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPine settings > App.
Enable voice comments

Lets you turn on PineDrama's voice comments, so you can record and post a spoken comment, for accounts that don't have them yet. It hasn't been tried on a real account, so it may not work. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPine settings > Comm…
Expand activity list
Shows the whole Activity and New followers lists in the Inbox, so you don't have to tap View all. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPine settings > Inbox.
Feature Gate Lab

Adds an advanced page that lists the hidden settings PineDrama uses to test features and lets you change them. It's for people who like to experiment. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPine settings > Diagnostics.
Feature Gate Recorder

Records which hidden PineDrama settings the app reads while you use it, and which ones changed. It's a research tool and changes nothing in PineDrama. Start a recording in HushPine settings > Diagnostics.
Feed filter

Hides ads in the feed, and lets you hide other things you don't want to see, like LIVEs, Shop posts, AI videos or videos with words, creators or sounds you pick. Hiding ads is on by default. Everything else starts off in HushPine settings…
Fit the video to the screen

Shows the whole video instead of cutting off its sides on folding phones, squarer screens and split screen, and fits photo slideshows whole on squarer screens. A second switch does the opposite and fills the screen. Starts off. Turn it on…
Fix Google login
Makes Sign in with Google work in the patched app, where it would otherwise fail. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.
Ghost mode

Stops PineDrama telling people you viewed their story or profile, or that you're typing. What PineDrama already recorded stays. A separate switch hides your online status. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPine settings > Privacy.
Hide comment popup ads
Stops the brand animation that pops up over the comments when someone types a word or emoji an advertiser paid for. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPine settings > Comments.
Hide comment typing suggestions
Hides the emoji and sticker suggestions that pop up above the comment box while you type. The emoji and sticker buttons still work. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPine settings > Comments.
Hide feed follow button
Removes the + follow button under creators' pictures on the feed, so you don't follow someone by accident. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPine settings > Feed screen.
Hide feed save button
Removes the save button from the right side of the feed, for a cleaner screen. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPine settings > Feed screen.
Hide feed search button
Removes the search button from the top right of the feed, for a cleaner screen. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPine settings > Feed screen.
Hide floating promotions

Hides the floating promotion badges, coins and timers on the feed, and can hide the rewards button on your profile. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPine settings > Feed screen, and App for the rewards button.
Hide inbox items

Lets you hide Inbox rows you don't use, like message requests and TikTok Shop, plus call buttons and suggested replies in chats. Each has its own switch. Also offers search in loaded Activity notifications. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPi…
Hide Play Store update offer

Stops the Play Store offering to swap the patched PineDrama for the store version. The catch: a build with a lower version number won't install over it, and uninstalling to go back can erase PineDrama's data on your phone.
Hide profile shortcuts
Hides the shortcuts you pick from under a profile's bio, if PineDrama shows any there. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPine settings > App, then restart PineDrama.
Hide search suggestions
Hides the searches PineDrama suggests before you type, and can hide the search rewards banner. Your own search history stays. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPine settings > App.
Hide suggested accounts
Hides PineDrama's People you may like suggestions in the Inbox, on profiles and in the feed. It uses the same switch as Hide inbox items. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPine settings > Inbox.
Hide the launcher shortcuts
Empties the menu that pops up when you press and hold PineDrama's icon on your home screen. Tapping the icon still opens the app. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPine settings > App.
Hold-and-slide 2x lock
Turns on PineDrama's own gesture where you hold a video, slide down and let go to keep it playing fast without holding. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPine settings > Feed screen.
In-app browser privacy guard

Stops websites you open in PineDrama's built-in browser from reaching into the PineDrama app. PineDrama's own pages, like Watch history and checkout, keep working. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPine settings > Privacy.
Keep a streak going
Sends a daily message you choose to people you pick, at a time you set, so your message streaks keep going on days you don't open PineDrama. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPine settings > Inbox.
Keep playing in the background

Keeps the video playing when you leave PineDrama or turn the screen off, with a notification to pause it. It can also start the video over when it ends. Handy for music and talks. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPine settings > Playback, the…
Keep pulled sounds
Plays the sound on videos PineDrama muted for copyright or because of where you live. PineDrama may still say the sound isn't available. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPine settings > Playback.
Keep recent stickers
Adds Recently used above Saved in the comment sticker panel, with the last stickers you sent, and keeps it when you close and reopen the app. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.
Keep the app language

Lets you keep the language you picked in PineDrama's own settings. When PineDrama starts and decides the phone's language changed, it drops that pick and follows the phone, which can leave it in the wrong language after a reboot. Starts of…
Keep the Favorites tab

Keeps the Favorites tab and your saved videos on your profile when PineDrama tries out a version of the app that hides them, and makes the collections popup you get by holding the Favorites button dark when PineDrama is. Both are on by def…
Keep the screen's refresh rate
Stops PineDrama slowing your screen down to the video's frame rate, so scrolling stays smooth on 90 or 120 Hz phones. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPine settings > App.
Limit background traffic
Lets you stop PineDrama loading upcoming videos ahead of time, which uses less data in the background, but videos may take a moment longer to start. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPine settings > App.
Load all saved stickers
Loads every sticker you saved when you open the sticker panel. PineDrama otherwise shows only the first 100 and never loads the rest. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.
Location access governor
Gives PineDrama no location when it asks, so it can't see where you are from your phone's location services. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPine settings > Privacy.
Look like the store app

Makes the patched app answer PineDrama's checks as if it came from the Play Store, which can help when follows or likes undo themselves. PineDrama has other checks, so it may not be enough. On once picked. Turn it off in HushPine settings…
Network proxy

Sends PineDrama's feed, search and comments through a proxy server you set up. Videos and LIVEs still load directly, and so do HushPine's own saves and short-link lookups. Other apps aren't affected. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPine sett…
Network request report
Counts the requests PineDrama sends to its servers and adds the totals to the diagnostic report. It changes nothing in PineDrama, but it has no switch and most people don't need it.
Notification controls

Lets you turn off new follower notifications and streak reminders, which PineDrama has no switch for, or turn off PineDrama's notifications altogether. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPine settings > Inbox.
Open external links directly
Opens website links from profiles and stories in your phone's own browser instead of PineDrama's built-in one. On by default. Turn it off in HushPine settings > Privacy.
Open the comments at full height
Opens the comment sheet at the full height of the screen instead of part way up. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPine settings > Comments.
Play SDR instead of HDR
Plays the normal version of HDR videos, so your screen doesn't suddenly jump to full brightness. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPine settings > Playback.
Playback quality
Lets you choose the video quality, like highest, lowest or 720p, and set a lower quality for mobile data to use less data. Starts off. Pick a quality in HushPine settings > Playback.
Playback speed

Remembers the speed you picked for the next video, and lets you set a default speed, add speeds up to 3x to the menu and choose the speed for press and hold. On by default. Turn it off in HushPine settings > Playback.
Prefer H.264 playback

Plays videos in an older format your phone decodes more easily, which can help older phones play smoothly and run cooler. Videos without it play as before. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPine settings > Playback.
Profile background

Opens PineDrama's own profile background editor in Edit profile on accounts PineDrama hasn't offered it to yet, and shows the backgrounds other profiles have set. PineDrama's servers may still refuse to save one for such an account. Starts…
Region spoof

Makes PineDrama's region and time zone match the country you set for SIM spoof. It changes every region check, sign-in included, and its store region switch is experimental, so it isn't picked for you. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPine se…
Remember clear display

Keeps clear display, PineDrama's mode that hides the buttons over a video, on as you swipe to the next video (`Keep Clear display across videos` turns that part off). It can also turn on by itself after a delay you pick, which starts off i…
Remove unused language packs

Removes the app languages you don't list in this patch's options, saving up to about 26 MB of storage. English is always kept. With no list it keeps them all. Only patching again brings removed ones back.
Resource and battery governor

Stops PineDrama reading your phone's motion sensors, which it can use to identify your phone, and stops a background speed test that can use a lot of memory. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPine settings > Privacy.
Resume videos after scrolling
When you scroll back to a video, it picks up where you left off instead of starting over. On by default. Turn it off in HushPine settings > Playback.
Sanitize sharing links
Removes the tracking codes from PineDrama links you share, so the link carries less about you. It can also swap tiktok.com for another site. On by default. Turn it off in HushPine settings > Privacy.
Settings

Adds the HushPine settings page to PineDrama, at the top of Settings and privacy. Pressing and holding any tab at the top of the feed opens it too. That's where you turn HushPine's features on and off. Works as soon as you patch it in, wit…
Show commenter handle and region

Shows a commenter's @username in place of their display name and the country their account is set to after the comment's time. It can also give each commenter's name a color of its own. Each starts off. Turn them on in HushPine settings >…
Show LIVE search
Adds PineDrama's search button inside the LIVE section where PineDrama supports it, so you can look for LIVEs. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPine settings > App.
Show the progress bar

Shows the progress bar on videos where PineDrama hides it, so you can see how long a video is and skip around. On by default. Turn it off in HushPine settings > Playback, where you can also show the time beside the bar or give it a bigger…
Show the progress bar thumbnail
Shows a small preview picture while you drag the progress bar, so you can find the part you want. On by default. Turn it off in HushPine settings > Playback.
SIM spoof

Makes PineDrama see the SIM country and carrier you choose. It may not change your region, since PineDrama also goes by your internet connection and account. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPine settings > Region.
Skip content warnings
Plays videos without the warning screen you'd have to tap through first, and can hide the Check sources and Check your sources banners. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPine settings > Feed screen.
Skip first-launch setup

Skips PineDrama's setup screens on a fresh install, like the interest picker and the swipe tutorial. Sign-in and age screens still show. Its switch is on once picked, since setup runs before you can reach settings. Turn it off in HushPine…
Skip passkey sign-in

Lets you sign in another way, like your password or a code by email or text, when PineDrama wants a passkey. Password managers won't hand a passkey to a patched app, so that step can't finish here. With the switch on, PineDrama treats your…
Skip the splash ad
Lets you stop the full-screen ad PineDrama can show while it starts up. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPine settings > App.
Skip update checks

Lets you stop two background tasks PineDrama uses to check for updates, one of them when your phone starts. Some in-app update prompts may stop. Play Store updates still work. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPine settings > App.
Stay on the video in full screen
When a video ends in PineDrama's full screen view, it stays on that video instead of moving to the next one. Swiping still moves on. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPine settings > Playback.
Stop on-device AI profiling

Lets you stop PineDrama's built-in AI engine from starting, so it doesn't get a copy of everything PineDrama logs about your use. PineDrama works as if the engine weren't there. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPine settings > Privacy.
Stop recording watch history

Stops PineDrama adding the videos you watch to your Watch history. The catch: your views stop counting, and your feed learns less about what you like. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPine settings > Privacy.
Stop saving search history

Stops PineDrama saving your new searches on your phone. Older searches stay until you delete them, and PineDrama's servers may keep their own record. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPine settings > Privacy.
Stop search autoplay
Stops videos in search results from playing by themselves. Each one shows its cover until you open it, so searching stays quiet. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPine settings > App.
Translate comments

Translates comments as they load, using PineDrama's own translator, so you don't have to tap Translate on each one. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPine settings > Comments, where more rows list languages PineDrama's automatic translation sh…
Trust user certificates

Lets PineDrama trust security certificates you install yourself, so a tool like mitmproxy can show what the app sends. The risk: anyone who gets a certificate onto your phone can read PineDrama's traffic too. Use it only on a test phone.
Turn off haptics
Stops the little vibrations PineDrama makes when you tap or hold things. Your keyboard and your phone's own vibrations stay. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPine settings > App.
Turn off screen transitions
Opens and closes PineDrama's screens without the sliding animation, so moving around feels quicker. Swipes still follow your finger. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPine settings > App.
Use non-personalized search
Shows search results that aren't tailored to your account. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPine settings > App.
Use system font

Shows PineDrama's text in your phone's own font or in a .ttf or .otf font file you import, instead of PineDrama's, and can use your phone's emoji too. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPine settings > App, then restart PineDrama.
